scope.purpose: Selectively port upstream SCHNAPS correctness fixes onto the qualified HICAR restart baseline without merging the upstream rename, build-system migration, or optional features.

upstream_audit.head: 622c2d42f6939b94f77fe6f68eb9cf5d822e1ab1
upstream_audit.coverage: Every commit after the shared ancestor was classified; every commit touching src/, tests/, CMakeLists.txt, or helpers/domains/ received a file-level review. Diverged topic branches contained older pre-squash work, not newer development beyond main.
ported_changes: Morrison GPU top-level sedimentation sign and removal of racy unused GPU arrays
Morrison CPU OpenMP privatization and CPU/GPU arithmetic ordering
density halo exchange immediately before wind updates
extra-dimension I/O setup, reversed vertical-boundary indexing, and psim metadata
defined initialization of domain, soil, and option state
OpenACC map-factor lifecycle on compute ranks
manual vertical-grid preservation and regression checks
compiler policy preventing decomposition-dependent advection contraction

deliberately_deferred.reason: The z-coordinate warning and cumulus GPU guard do not affect the structured forcing or convection-disabled production configuration.
Compressed NetCDF output and Zarr forcing are optional features requiring a separate format and throughput qualification.
Assertion removal and the I/O cleanup are refactors with no additional applicable correctness fix.
The remaining cuFFT linear-wind, SNOWPACK, snow-drift, and fine-mesh metadata changes target physics not enabled by the current workflow.
The remaining output-index helper hardens unsupported requested 1-D/4-D outputs; current production lists contain only supported 2-D/3-D fields.
The new upstream domain-builder and polar GeoTIFF mosaic fix are not used by the project-owned, validated Alpine domain builder; the reported seam failure is polar rather than Alpine.
